messages:
Alex (Support): Passing to CS — Veridian Health trial blocked: embed ingest returning 429s during onboarding. Marking as P0.
Alex (Support): Ticket: https://redwood.zendesk.com/tickets/7654321 org=veridian-health-prod. Log excerpt: ```2026-03-22T15:02:03Z ERROR rate_limit exceeded org=veridian-health-prod route=/v1/embeds```
Maria (CS): Acknowledged. Jamal, renewal window in two weeks on this account, right?
Jamal (CSM): Yep, renewal signal strong. If activation stalls we risk churn. Recommend immediate temporary mitigation + customer comms.
Tanvi (Success): I can run the enablement call tomorrow. Maria, can you send an apology + short status note to buy time?
Maria (CS): Draft: "Hi Veridian — were on it. Applied a temporary mitigation while we investigate. Would you share the sample payload? Well schedule a short troubleshooting call." Edits welcome.
Nick (Customer Engineer): If you drop the payload I can repro. Proposing a short-term route to Dedicated nodes for this org while we debug (cost minimal, fast). Need eng-runtime OK.
Alex (Support): Payload attached in ticket (payload.json).
Oncall Bot: Incident created INC-2026-0347 severity=P0 assigned=eng-runtime.
Jamal (CSM): Action plan: 1) Maria send comms in 30m, 2) Nick request routing/quota change, 3) Tanvi schedule enablement call, 4) CS mark renewal risk as elevated.
Maria (CS): Sent comms at ts=5129890040.
Nick (Customer Engineer): Requested Dedicated route & quota bump in #eng-runtime. Pinging oncall for quick approval.
Oncall Bot: eng-runtime acknowledged. Change queued: ROUTE-842 temporary route + quota until 2026-03-29.
Alex (Support): Relayed status to customer. They replied: "Thanks, were available for a call. Sending sample payload now"
Tanvi (Success): Meeting scheduled 2026-03-23 14:00 PT. Agenda: reproduce, config checks, quick mitigation steps.
Jamal (CSM): I opened a renewal watch and added notes: "activation blocked by embed 429, mitigated by temporary routing; follow up after enablement." Setting risk -> high until post-call confirmation.
Maria (CS): Post-call summary template: root cause hypothesis, mitigation applied, customer actions, sentiment + next steps. Ill paste summary here after call.
Alex (Support): Customer confirmed they can proceed after the session. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-0347 status=mitigated assigned=eng-runtime
Maria (CS): Final: CS owns follow-ups and renewal outreach. Support will keep ticket open to monitor regressions.
